name: The Observatory on a Floating Island in the Clouds
description: An old, brass-and-wood observatory dome perched on a lush, green floating island, surrounded by a soft, endless sea of clouds with distant mountain peaks poking through.
prompt: An old, vintage observatory with a brass dome and wooden structure, perched on a lush, green floating island. The island is surrounded by a vast, soft sea of white clouds, with distant, majestic mountain peaks emerging from the cloud layer. The scene is bathed in the warm, soft light of sunrise or sunset. Serene, sci-fi, fantasy, highly detailed.
caption: Watching the universe from a quiet island drifting softly among the endless clouds. 🌌🔭
